title: Story Brief
description: Structured story intake produced by the story-to-storyboard story_intake stage. Normalizes story blueprints, SC story cards, fable drafts, free text, or reverse-engineered reference videos into one input contract for the script stage.

mode.description: How the story arrived. reference_video means the brief was reverse-derived from a reference video via brief-to-beat-bridge.

document_path.description: Original read-only source document (e.g. 07产出 story blueprint or SC story card).

snapshot_path.description: Snapshot of the adopted source text inside the project workspace.

video_analysis_brief_path.description: Path to the video_analysis_brief artifact when mode=reference_video.

premise.description: One-sentence story premise: who wants what, and what stands in the way.

theme.description: The underlying message or moral the piece argues for.

appearance.description: Stable visual identity (age, clothing, features) reused by downstream consistency checks.

emotional_arc.description: Ordered emotional phases the viewer should travel through.

structure.description: Story spine. Mirrors the script-blueprint-writer fields.

landing.description: Closing beat design — where the piece must land.

structure_template_ref.description: Optional reference to a structure template distilled from the benchmark analysis library.

protagonist_type.description: e.g. two-animal fable / child protagonist / object parable
